Yes, the search behaviour feels right.

Recognising the operators in any capitalisation is more forgiving, and quoted operators behaving as ordinary words is what I’d expect. The `NOT`, then `AND`, then `OR` order also makes sense, with parentheses available when I want to be explicit.

Quietly falling back to a simple search for malformed queries is acceptable; I’d rather still get useful results than be stopped by an error. Searching notes as well is exactly what I want once note-writing is available.
